edge_case_tests.edge_case: 1. Same-Day Multi-Whale Cumulative Daily Limit Guard
edge_case_tests.detail: Whale #1 fills remaining daily Mudrex room (₹12,464.34 + existing ₹35.66 = ₹12,500.00); Whale #2 & Whale #3 on same day send ₹0.00 to Mudrex and 100% (₹257,608.32 + ₹104,012.90) directly to MetaMask Backup (0xFF3c...89BE)!
Even after you sell USDC -> INR in Mudrex (making on-chain Mudrex USDC drop to 0), mudrex_daily_limit_ledger.json remembers today's IST cumulative deposit so it never double-sends on the same day.

edge_case_tests.edge_case: 3. Cumulative Lifetime Tier Limit Guard (L0 ₹50k -> L1 ₹10L -> L5 ₹14Cr)
edge_case_tests.detail: Enforces both daily_cap_units and lifetime_cap_units simultaneously before any transfer to Mudrex.

edge_case_tests.edge_case: 4. Mudrex Minimum Deposit Floor (> 0.005 USDC = 5,001 units)
edge_case_tests.detail: Blocks dust transfers <= 0.005 USDC so zero micro-amounts are lost to exchange minimum deposit rules.

edge_case_tests.edge_case: 5. Aave V3 50% Close Factor (0.95 < HF < 1.0000) & 100% Close Factor (HF <= 0.95)
edge_case_tests.detail: Verified 0 revert ('0x') on both shallow trigger (HF 0.9989) and deep trigger (HF 0.9341).

edge_case_tests.edge_case: 6. WETH/ETH Profit Auto-Conversion to USDC via Uniswap V3 (0xE592...1564)
edge_case_tests.detail: Converts WETH liquidation profit (Row #6: 0.4533 WETH) into clean USDC before splitting between Mudrex and MetaMask.

edge_case_tests.edge_case: 7. Single 3rd-Profitable Whale Alone Trigger (Only #3 < 1.0000 While #1 & #2 Stay > 1.0000)
edge_case_tests.detail: When ETH pumps so ONLY #3 (0x9f25...9052, WETH Debt/USDT Col) drops to HF 0.998599 while #1 & #2 stay >1.0000, execution_queue skips #1 & #2 and immediately executes #3 alone (+₹104,012.90 -> ₹12,464.34 Mudrex + ₹91,548.56 MetaMask)!

edge_case_tests.edge_case: 8. Math.round(HF, 1) == 1.0 Pre-Warmed Zero-Delay Sniper & Multi-Whale Sequential Queue
edge_case_tests.detail: Pre-warms calldata whenever round(HF, 1) == 1.0 (0ms encoding delay) and executes all triggered whales in strict High-to-Low profit order (#1 -> #2 -> #3).
